playback.audio_offset.description: Player menu row and its page: shifts this channel's sound against the picture

playback.default_audio_offset.description: Settings > Playback row: the audio offset of every channel without its own

playback.display_16_9.description: Display mode: the picture shown at 16:9

playback.display_4_3.description: Display mode: the picture shown at 4:3

playback.display_fill.description: Display mode: the screen covered, the overhang cropped

playback.display_mode.description: Player menu row and Settings > Appearance > Player row: how the picture fills the screen

playback.display_normal.description: Display mode: the picture's own aspect, fitted inside the screen

playback.sleep_cancelled.description: Toast: the sleep timer was turned off

playback.sleep_done.description: Toast: the sleep timer ran out and playback stopped

playback.sleep_left.description: Player menu value of the sleep timer row: minutes until playback stops

playback.sleep_off.description: Sleep timer option and row value: no timer

playback.sleep_set.description: Toast: a sleep timer was set

playback.sleep_soon.description: Toast one minute before the sleep timer stops playback

playback.sleep_timer.description: Player menu row and its page: stop playback after a while
